address_pairs.kinship: Kunlun Senior Disciple to visiting martial artist
address_pairs.speaker: 학수

continuity: The ships are carrying the allies across Qinghai Lake; they expect to reach their destination in about half a day.
Hak Su is Cheongheoja’s Senior Disciple, Hak Woo’s senior brother, and a possible successor to the Kunlun Sect leadership.
Taekyung believes the Lord of Heaven does not want him killed, based on the Grand Mage’s choice to spare him in Gansu; the reason remains unknown.
The black-robed captive has been submerged in Qinghai Lake for a day and night and now promises to talk; no information has yet been obtained.
plot: Aboard the ships crossing Qinghai Lake, Jin Taekyung meets Hak Su, Cheongheoja’s Senior Disciple and Hak Woo’s senior brother. Hak Su expects the Alliance Leader and righteous warriors to join them, but Taekyung doubts the Central Plains can commit its full strength while Dark Heaven can use the Moving Formation. Taekyung reflects that the Lord of Heaven may want him alive, though he still cannot understand the reason. He and Hyuk Mujin haul the bound black-robed captive from the lake; the captive promises to talk, but reveals no information in this chapter.
translation_decisions: Use Hak Su for 학수; Taekyung’s mistaken 학소 (Hakso) is a name-confusion joke, not an alternate name.
Keep Taekyung’s conclusion that the Lord of Heaven wants him alive framed as his belief, not confirmed fact.

active_continuity: The allies are crossing Qinghai Lake by ship and expect to reach their destination in about half a day.
Hak Su is Cheongheoja’s Senior Disciple, Hak Woo’s senior brother, and a possible successor to the Kunlun Sect leadership.
Taekyung believes the Lord of Heaven does not want him killed, but does not know why.
The black-robed captive is being interrogated after a day and night submerged in the lake; he has promised to talk but has given no information.
open_questions: Who is the black-robed captive, and what does he know?
Why did the Lord of Heaven spare Taekyung in Gansu, and what is his real purpose?
Will the Alliance Leader and other righteous warriors reach Qinghai?
What is the hidden ember Cheongheoja warned about?

names.notes: Cheongheoja’s Senior Disciple and Hak Woo’s senior brother.

profile_creations.personality: Gracious and hopeful, he responds to Taekyung’s mistakes with patience and warmth.
profile_creations.relationships: Cheongheoja is his Master, and Hak Woo is his youngest Junior Brother; he treats Jin Taekyung warmly as a Fellow Daoist.
profile_creations.role: Hak Su is Cheongheoja’s Senior Disciple and a senior brother to Hak Woo in the Kunlun Sect.
profile_creations.voice: He speaks in courteous, formal phrases and tempers earnest reassurance with hearty, lightly humorous remarks.
